title: TikTok — three numbers that matter more than price
hook: Three numbers matter more than the price on a used jet.
body: Price gets the attention. These three decide what you actually pay.

script.voiceover: Everybody stares at the price. These three numbers matter more.
One — time since the last major inspection. A fresh clock can be worth six figures.
Two — engine program status. On a program means predictable costs. Off it, you're the insurance.
Three — total time and cycles for the type. Low time protects your resale.
Read those three before you ever talk price. Vertical Jet Sales.
